changes.title: Per-door-instance exclusion checkbox in Clearance Check, so individual doors can be skipped without changing category-wide settings
changes.description: Each door instance now exposes an "Exclude from Clearance Check" parameter. Excluded doors keep their clearance families but are ignored by the validation run.

media.caption: The new exclusion checkbox on a door instance.

changes.title: By-view visibility control for clearance family instances
changes.description: Clearance geometry can be shown or hidden per view without deleting the instances.

changes.title: Category scoping now runs before the Clearance Check tool executes, cutting down on manual pre-filtering
changes.description: Pick the categories once and the tool limits the element collection up front, which noticeably shortens run time on large models.

changes.title: Conditional schedule formatting flags clearance issues directly in Revit schedules
changes.description: Failing rows are highlighted so issues can be reviewed without leaving the schedule view.

media.caption: Failing clearance rows highlighted in a Revit schedule.

changes.title: Fixed an "Unrecoverable Error" crash caused by the Sheet Utilities component being compiled against a different Revit patch level
changes.description: The component is now built against the baseline API surface shared by all supported patch levels.

changes.title: Resolved an ILRepack runtime exception affecting Microsoft.Data.Sqlite on .NET Framework 4.8 builds
changes.description: Native SQLite dependencies are no longer merged into the main assembly and are deployed alongside it instead.

changes.title: Migrated deprecated Curve.Intersect calls to the Revit 2027-compatible CurveIntersectResult API ahead of the 2027 release
changes.description: No behavioural change for existing users; the migration keeps the add-in compiling cleanly against Revit 2027.

releases.summary: Sheet Utilities rewrite & faster model audits

changes.title: Batch sheet renaming with reusable naming rules
changes.description: Naming rules can be saved per project and re-applied to newly created sheets.

changes.title: Model audit results are now streamed to the UI as they are produced
changes.description: Long audits report progress instead of blocking until completion.

changes.title: Fixed shared parameter binding being dropped when a project template was upgraded
changes.description: Bindings are re-applied after the upgrade and verified before the transaction is committed.

changes.title: Clearance Check tool for doors and equipment
changes.description: Places parametric clearance families and validates them against surrounding geometry.

changes.title: Minimum supported Revit version raised to 2022
changes.description: Revit 2021 builds are no longer published.
